_readme: Central code-factor register used by every tool. status: V = confirmed from a named source (search excerpt); C = standard clause content / recommended value, NA may differ; U = unverified typical value. Override any value in a PROJECT file (same structure, only the keys you change) and pass it with --factors project.json or env TENSILE_FACTORS=project.json. Run `python3 factors.py report` to list everything still unverified. Unverified (U) entries carry a 'range' used by --sensitivity checks: tools re-run the governing check at both ends and report whether the decision depends on the unverified value.

stress_factor_short.source: ASCE 55-10 'current industry practice' FS 4.0 for prestress + wind (ASCE 55-10 text) and general 4–5 practice (Birdair, literature)

stress_factor_long.source: ASCE 55-10 'current industry practice' FS 5.0 for prestress + snow; Birdair 'usually 5'. (P + D alone: 8.0, see fm159_PD)

fm159_PD.source: FM Global DS 1-59 (2021) Table 2.2.6.1, P+D, new-fabric strength

japan_long_divisor.source: MLIT Notification 666 (reported); ETFE paper (PMC9735748) quotes Japanese K = 8 long-term (single source); unclear whether K applies to ETFE or to fabric

japan_short_divisor.source: MLIT Notification 666 (reported); ETFE paper (PMC9735748) quotes Japanese K = 4 short-term (single source)

seam_efficiency.source: PVC HF 0.80-0.90, PTFE heat-seal 0.70-0.80 (tensilecraft); use test value

partial.source: German A-factor practice (Bautechnik 'Materialprüfung und Bemessung im Zelt- und Membranbau'; Knippers, Construction Manual for Polymers + Membranes): fabric γM 1.4 (connections 1.5), A0 1.0–1.2, A1 1.6–1.7, A2 1.1–1.2, A3 1.1–1.25 (connections 1.4–1.95). NOT CEN/TS 19102:2023 values (Annex C / NA not retrieved) — placeholder
partial.range_source: product A0·A1·A2·A3 over the reported German ranges relative to the table values (1.936 … 3.06 vs 2.47 for PES/PVC)

gamma_prestress.source: Eng. Struct. 214 (2020) calibration: gP=1.0 with gS=gW=2.0 (or gP=1.2 with 1.5)

gamma_variable.source: EN 1990 gQ; calibration study suggests 2.0 with gP=1.0

asce55_10_PD.source: ASCE 55-10 industry-practice FS for prestress + dead (consistent with FM DS 1-59)

tear_factor.source: no code value found; practice: design stress ≤ critical-slit (tear propagation) resistance / ≥ 2 — agree with the checking engineer; second search: codes check tensile strength only, tear strength treated as a material property (Han Bao et al. 2022, J. Ind. Textiles)

etfe_gamma.source: CEN/TS 19102 ETFE base material γM0 = 1.10 (f_u23 = 40 MPa -> f_Rd 36.4 MPa; SLS elastic limit f_el23 = 15 MPa; welds γM1 1.15–1.45 by quality level) — Stranghöner TexComp 2021, IASS 2024 paper 247 (one paper line seen in 3 searches). Tool applies it to the first-yield stress (conservative)

rho_air.source: EN 1991-1-4 4.5(1) Note 2 recommended air density 1.25 kg/m³

added_mass_coeff.source: Lamb (1920) added virtual mass of a clamped circular plate vibrating in one fluid side: 0.6689·ρ·r; used per side for a membrane panel with r = equivalent-area radius (approximation, mode shape differs)
added_mass_coeff.range_source: membrane vs plate mode shapes, panel aspect ratio; wind-tunnel added-mass studies scatter

corner_ply_eff.source: load share of each welded reinforcement ply taken = seam efficiency (practice assumption; confirm by corner test)

gammaR.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.2 (NDP): 1.00; 0.90 only where measures at the anchorages reduce bending from cable rotation (7.1(4)) [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet]; ETAs (Fatzer ETA-15/0917, Pfeifer, Teufelberger; DIBt Z-14.7-759) use 1.0, values < 1.0 not permitted by DIBt

ke_socket.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.3 / EAD 200001-00-0602: metal/resin sockets 1.0 (Teufelberger, Fatzer ETA)

ke_swaged.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.3 / EAD 200001-00-0602: swaged 0.9 (Teufelberger, Fatzer ETA, Ronstan)

ke_ferrule.source: EN 13411-3 ferrule-secured eye terminal efficiency 0.9 (product standard); EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.3 value not confirmed

ke_ubolt.source: EN 13411-5 U-bolt grip must hold ≥ 80 % MBF (product standard); Fatzer ETA lists rope clamps at 0.85 (single source); EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.3 value not confirmed

f_sls.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 7.2: f_SLS = 0.45 σ_uk where fatigue incl. bending stresses is not verified; 0.50 σ_uk when it is (use f_sls_bending_checked) [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; condition wording from a snippet: confirm]. Teufelberger fatigue tests use σ_sup = 0.45 σ_uk
f_sls.range_source: the two Table 7.2 values (condition wording from a single snippet)

clamp_mu.source: EN 1993-1-11 gives NO default μ: determine by test (clamp slip test). 0.1 is a conservative placeholder; literature uses 0.15–0.2 (Ruan 2019, Adv. Civ. Eng. doi:10.1155/2019/1438754)

clamp_gamma.source: EN 1993-1-11 γM,fr = 1.65 recommended [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet]; Ruan 2019 (Adv. Civ. Eng.); Sci. Rep. 2025 s41598-025-89571-3. Check: F∥ ≤ μ(F⊥ + F_r)/γM,fr

clamp_loss.source: residual clamping force after losses F_r (EN 1993-1-11 lists creep, diameter reduction under tension, compaction/ovalisation, bolt relaxation, temperature); 0.8 is a practice placeholder — re-tighten after stressing

saddle_p_lim_FLC.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.4 transverse pressure q_Rk without tests, full locked coil on steel [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; single snippet: confirm]

saddle_p_lim_OSS.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.4 transverse pressure q_Rk without tests, spiral strand on steel [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; single snippet: confirm]

saddle_min_R_over_d.source: practice minimum saddle radius ~20–30 d (OSS) / 20–40 d (FLC); below: strength reduction per supplier / ASCE 19 N_d; EN 1993-1-11 designs saddles for k·F_uk (k NDP, value not found)

f_sls_bending_checked.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 7.2: 0.50 σ_uk when the fatigue check includes bending stresses [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; confirm condition wording]

f_const_install.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 7.1 f_const = 0.60 / 0.55 σ_uk depending on the installation phase [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; confirm which phase takes which value]

saddle_p_lim_FLC_lined.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.4 transverse pressure q_Rk without tests, full locked coil with soft lining [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; single snippet: confirm]

saddle_p_lim_OSS_lined.source: EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.4 transverse pressure q_Rk without tests, spiral strand with soft lining [NF EN 1993-1-11 full text (French edition, pdfcoffee.com) via search snippet; single snippet: confirm]

k2_thread.source: EN 1993-1-8 Table 3.4 bolt tension k2 = 0.9 (0.63 countersunk); used for threaded tension rods on A_s

phi_v.source: AISC 360-22 G1 (1.0/Ω 1.50 for rolled I webs h/tw ≤ 2.24√(E/Fy))

phi_weld.source: AISC 360-22 Table J2.5 fillet weld metal

bolt_F.source: AISC 360 Table J3.2 nominal stresses [MPa]: Fnt; Fnv threads included (N) / excluded (X)

gamma_G_stb.source: EN 1997-1 Table A.1 (EQU) stabilising permanent action

gamma_G_dst.source: EN 1997-1 Table A.1 (EQU) destabilising permanent action

gamma_Q_dst.source: EN 1997-1 Table A.1 (EQU) destabilising variable action

gamma_R_h.source: EN 1997-1 Table A.4 R2 sliding resistance (Design Approach 2)

gamma_conc.source: EN 1991-1-1 Table A.1 plain concrete ~24 kN/m3

helical_Kt_per_m.source: Hubbell/CHANCE torque correlation Kt ≈ 10 ft^-1 for 1.5-1.75 in square shafts; use manufacturer / load test
helical_Kt_per_m.range_source: torque factor spread by shaft size (Hubbell)

helical_FS.source: common allowable-load factor of safety on torque-correlated ultimate capacity; verify with local code

phi_sliding_US.source: no single US/SBC value for block sliding: AASHTO LRFD φ_τ = 0.8 (cast-in-place on sand); ASD FS 1.5 (IBC 1807.2.3) ≈ 0.67

k_ucr_N.source: EN 1992-4 7.2.1.4 cast-in headed fasteners, uncracked (Hilti, IDEA StatiCa, civilaxis)

gamma_Ms_steel.source: EN 1992-4 Table 4.1: γMs = 1.2·f_uk/f_yk ≥ 1.4 (computed per anchor grade)

6082T6_fo_thin.source: 6082-T6 extrusions t ≤ 5 mm f_o (EN 755-2 / EN 1999-1-1 Table 3.2b)

bearing_formula.source: EN 1999-1-1 Table 8.5 F_b,Rd = k1·αb·f_u·d·t/γM2 (EN 1993-1-8 form; EN 1999 table not quoted verbatim)
bearing_formula.range_source: scale on F_b,Rd: EN 1993-1-8 form used; EN 1999-1-1 Table 8.5 k1/αb limits and edition changes may reduce it

gMf_safe_life_high.source: EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1 safe life, high consequence

gMf_safe_life_low.source: EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1 safe life, low consequence

gMf_damage_tol_high.source: EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1 damage tolerant, high consequence

gMf_damage_tol_low.source: EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1 damage tolerant, low consequence

dsC_spiral_socket.source: EN 1993-1-11 Section 9 category NOT confirmed (150 recalled); German NA route uses Δσc = 112 N/mm² for full-locked hangers (BASt Leitfaden Hänger)

dsC_threaded_bar.source: EN 1993-1-11 / EN 1993-1-9 threaded bolts in tension category 50 (recalled)
dsC_threaded_bar.range_source: threaded bars/bolts in tension (EN 1993-1-9 cat 50, reduced for large Ø)

m_rope.source: current EN 1993-1-11 uses m1 = 4, m2 = m1 + 2 = 6 for full-locked coil ropes (Maljaars, Steel Construction stco.202100009); tool uses m = 4 with no knee (conservative)
m_rope.range_source: rope S-N slope spread (FLC research m1 = 4)

codes._readme: Design code systems. Select with --code EU|US|SA or env TENSILE_CODE (project file key '_code'). Default EU.

US.source: ASCE 7-22, AISC 360-22, ASCE 55 (membranes), ASCE 19 (cables), ACI 318-19 Ch.17 (anchors), IBC 2024

SA.source: Saudi Building Code: values from the 2018 edition (official Arabic text): SBC 301 (ASCE 7-10 based), SBC 306 (AISC 360-10 based, LRFD only), SBC 304 (ACI 318-14), SBC 201 §3102 (ASCE 55 + NFPA 701). The 2024 edition is mandatory since 2025-07; its changes are NOT checked — confirm every SBC value against the edition in force

gamma_G_sup.source: EN 1990 Table A1.2(B) STR, unfavourable permanent

gamma_P.source: membrane prestress taken as permanent, γP = 1.0 (Eng. Struct. 214 (2020) calibration; CEN/TS 19102 practice)

psi0_snow.source: EN 1990 Table A1.1 snow, sites H ≤ 1000 m (Finland etc. 0.7)

psi0_roof_live.source: EN 1990 Table A1.1 category H roofs

terrain.source: EN 1991-1-4 Table 4.1: z0 / zmin [m] (NA may differ)

combos_lrfd_22.source: ASCE 7-22 §2.3.1 — ICC 'Demystifying Loads' 2024 IBC/ASCE 7-22 slides; ASCE Collaborate; Structure mag. (≥2 sources)

combos_asd_22.source: ASCE 7-22 §2.4.1 — ICC 'Demystifying Loads' 2024 IBC/ASCE 7-22 slides; ASCE Collaborate; Structure mag. (≥2 sources)

kz_22.source: ASCE 7-22 Table 26.11-1: K_z = 2.41(z/z_g)^(2/α), z ≥ 4.6 m (windload.solutions; ICC slides reproduce Table 26.10-1)

kz_10_16.source: ASCE 7-10/7-16 Table 26.9-1 / 26.11-1: K_z = 2.01(z/z_g)^(2/α), z ≥ 4.6 m (thestructuralworld; steelcalculator)

kz_zmin.source: ASCE 7: K_z evaluated at z ≥ 15 ft (4.6 m)

Kd_building.source: ASCE 7 Table 26.6-1 MWFRS/C&C of buildings (7-22: K_d applied in the pressure equation, not in q_z)

q_coef_SI.source: ASCE 7: q = 0.613·K_z·K_zt·(K_d)·K_e·V² N/m², V in m/s

beta.source: ASCE 55-10 Table 4-2 (read in full text); ASCE 55-16 values NOT verified. β calibrated with service-level (ASCE 7-98) wind -> use with ASD combinations (0.6W for ASCE 7-10+ strength-level wind)

Lt_permanent.source: ASCE 55-10 §4.4.2.1 life-cycle factor, permanent structure, ≥ 75 % strength retention

kc_cast.source: ACI 318-19 17.6.2.2.1 k_c = 24 (in-lb, spec text) -> 10 SI (unit conversion; confirm with 318M)

phi_breakout_cast.source: ACI 318-19 Table 17.5.3 cast-in, no supplementary reinforcement (0.75 with)

edition_note.source: Values from SBC 2018 (official Arabic text, NCBC 2019 print). SBC 2024 mandatory since 2025-07-01: changes not checked. The English CR text governs over AR.

phi_c_306.source: SBC 306-18 (AR text §E): φc = 0.85 'in all cases' (AISC 360: 0.90); confirm in SBC 306-CR and the 2024 edition

phi_v_306.source: SBC 306-18 (AR text): φv = 0.90 'in all cases' (AISC: 1.0 for rolled I webs); confirm

combos_301.source: SBC 301-18 §2.3.2 (AR text): strength combinations; snow and ice deleted. Combination with L reads 1.4D+1.7L+0.5(Lr or R) in the AR text (possible translation issue; L is rare on membrane roofs)

wind_basis.source: SBC 301-18: ASCE 7-10 wind chapters, q = 0.613·K_z·K_zt·K_d·V² (no K_e); V = ultimate 3-s gust at 10 m, exposure C (Fig. 26.5-1A/B/C, RC II 700 y), ~40–56 m/s across KSA (Riyadh ≈ 50, Jeddah ≈ 46–48 RC II, read from maps)

asd_note.source: SBC 306-18 is LRFD only (no ASD/Ω). ASCE 55 β method uses ASD-level loads: 0.6W assumed for SBC 301 ultimate wind (inference)

membrane_fire.source: SBC 201-18 §3102.3.1: membrane noncombustible (§703.5) or NFPA 701 Test Method 1/2; §3102.1.1 design to ASCE 55; §3102.7.1 membrane not to be used as lateral restraint of frame members
